caption: The drawing depicts a single object, a dark metallic spur laid horizontally against a plain light beige background. The spur consists of several components: on the left side, there is a large, circular, gear-like wheel with many evenly spaced, sharply pointed spikes radiating outward. This wheel is attached via a short, jointed metal arm, which features intricate, dotted, and cut-out decorative patterns. The metal arm transitions into a straight shaft that ends in two symmetrical, flat, looped attachments, each featuring a geometric design resembling an arrowhead or buckle. The overall coloration of the object is a dark bronze or brownish hue with subtle shading to suggest metallic texture. The composition focuses solely on the spur, which is centered on the page with no other objects or embellishments present.
title: Spur
